description: Run headless Blender (found via BLENDER or the usual install paths) with a GrowBlocks script. op "clean": a generated prop joined, decimated (tris), scaled (size in m along axis), pivot bottom/top/center, textures shrunk (tex). "ao": ambient occlusion baked into vertex colours (dist, rays). "voxelize": cells JSON (cell size, by material|object|kind). "export": a .blend to GLB with every action as a clip and custom properties as extras. "robot": builds a hard-surface robot or mech (bevelled curved armour shells with real panel gaps, drums, pistons, hoses, vents, one locked palette, AO + edge wear in vertex colours) from a design: file = "example:biped", "example:spider", a .py with build(kit) using the gb_mech library (copy an example from blender/) or a .json preset ({"design","palette","colors","params"}); joints are named nodes (pelvis/torso/head, shoulder/elbow/hand/muzzle L+R, hip/knee/ankle/toe L+R, jet0/1; walkers leg/knee/ankle/toe<i>) that animate by rotation and pair with gb.use("gait"). It returns the turnaround sheet (front, 3/4, side, back, close-up, test pose): look at it, fix the design, run again. options: palette (warden|raptor|olive|carbon|pearl), budget (triangles), param ("k=v,k=v"), merge 0 (one mesh per piece). Then growblocks_pack.

dir.description: The game folder (default: the folder the assistant runs in).

file.description: The model or .blend; for robot the design (example:biped, example:spider, my_robot.py, preset.json).

options.description: Script options, e.g. {"pivot":"bottom","size":1.8,"tris":5000}, {"cell":0.5} or for robot {"palette":"olive","budget":12000,"param":"pod=0"}.

name: growblocks_blender
title: Run headless Blender
